hooks.text: 船只就是可移动基地，玩家在5×8网格中布置火炮、装甲、维修站和仓储，形成不同战斗流派。
hooks.excerpt: Cannons on the sides, hull plates in the center, repair station at the stern, storage up front — a 5×8 grid where every loadout creates a different playstyle.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 海战不依赖鼠标瞄准，而靠舰船走位、切换左右舷射界，并在自动开火与手动齐射间选择。
hooks.excerpt: No cursor, no twitch-aim — combat is pure positioning. Pick your live broadside (port or starboard), swing it onto the enemy, and your guns roar out that side the moment a target's in the arc — auto-fire by default, or switch to manual and time the perfect volley.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 成长分为船长、舰船和船员三层：船长技能与经验跨局保留，舰船模块可永久升级，船员提供被动编组效果。
hooks.excerpt: Captain — earn XP from combat to spend on 9 skills across 3 branches (Combat / Navigator / Commander). A captain's XP and skill points are kept between runs — every voyage makes them permanently stronger, win or lose Ship — 17 modules, upgrades that survive defeat, a 5×8 grid you fill out over a run Crew — 6 crew archetypes with passive bonuses; your captain sets the roster (a signature crew plus auto-filled bonus slots), and supplies tick down between encounters
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
